title: India catalogue matching benchmark seed
labelPolicy: Human labels from observed names, brands, GTINs, labelled packs and category tags. SAME_VARIANT denotes a repeat observation of the same Open Food Facts entry. DIFFERENT_VARIANT denotes distinct trade items. UNCERTAIN requires packaging or brand-owner evidence before any merge.
limitations: A small, source-biased regression seed with no independent cross-retailer positive pairs. Repeated-source positives share the same Open Food Facts row and must stay in the same split. Keep all pairs sharing a canonical GTIN or product family in the same split. Exclude UNCERTAIN from supervised training and report abstentions separately. No model was trained or evaluated.

pairs.label: SAME_VARIANT
pairs.reason: Same Marks & Spencer 305 g Teriyaki Dip Sauce Marinade entry reproduced in overlapping ranges of the same dump.

pairs.label: DIFFERENT_VARIANT
pairs.reason: Parle-G with 45gm and 90g source pack labels and separate GTINs.

pairs.label: DIFFERENT_VARIANT
pairs.reason: Britannia Good Day cashew cookies with 52.5 g and 30.2 g pack labels and separate GTINs.

pairs.label: DIFFERENT_VARIANT
pairs.reason: Balaji Panjabi Tadka and Balaji Wafers Wheelos Masala Flavour have equal nominal 22 g packs but different named product lines and codes.

pairs.label: DIFFERENT_VARIANT
pairs.reason: Sting Energy and Red Bull Energy Drink are both 250 ml but have distinct brands, names and codes.

pairs.label: UNCERTAIN
pairs.reason: Sprite brand labels and normalized 250 ml pack agree, while GTINs and category details differ. Source labels alone cannot resolve a duplicate or reformulation.

pairs.label: UNCERTAIN
pairs.reason: Thums Up and Thumsup normalize to the same brand on two 250 ml cola records with different GTINs. Confirm package evidence before merging.
